text:
I have left sea and lands between myself
        and all the good I had, poor wretch;
        moving farther away each day,
        I have passed through peoples, customs, languages.


        I have lost hope of returning now;
        in my imagination I devise remedies,
        and the surest one I hope for is the day
        that will end both life and care.


        I could find relief from any ill
        by seeing you, my lady, or hoping to,
        if I could hope without losing that hope.


        But since I cannot see you to save myself,
        I find no remedy except to die;
        and if death is one, I cannot obtain it either.

translation.title: I have left the sea and lands between
translation.editorial_note: Imported as a translation without separate editorial review.
